name: spmanchester-svg-studio
description: Enterprise-grade, client-side SVG transformation suite by SPManchester Private Limited. 100% private in-browser conversion to PNG, WebP, JPG, PDF, ICO, BMP, and Base64.
author: Sayed Mudassar Akbar <info@spmanchester.com>

scripts.test: node -e "console.log('Validating project structure...'); const fs = require('fs'); ['svg-to-png','svg-to-webp','svg-to-jpg','svg-to-pdf','svg-to-ico','svg-to-bmp','svg-to-base64'].forEach(dir => { if(!fs.existsSync(dir + '/index.html')) throw new Error('Missing index.html in ' + dir); }); console.log('All 7 converter suites intact and verified successfully.');"
